cards.label: Bermondsey — James's unit
cards.text: BizBrief is open on Archie's phone, propped against the hourglass. Owen has been given a chair for the occasion and is not sure what to do with it.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "Right. Two orders, a full week each, and none of us laid a finger on them. {periodOne}. {periodTwo}."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "This payday the pot took {receipts}. Owen's wages come out first: {owenWage}."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "What's left splits three ways. {archieShare} to me, {jamesShare} to James, {playerShare} to you."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "It ran without us. You get that? Money made while you were off doing something else."
James takes a long time to put his cup down.

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: "The pearls were within tolerance, the buyer paid on time, and nobody needed anything explained twice. I will call that adequate."
Owen goes back to his veins, James to his own clients. On Archie's phone, next week's orders are already coming in.
